text:
oncall-bot: Paging: embedding-encode latency > 1.5s (p95) in eu-west1 for service/embedding-proxy. Triggered by 1965 slow encode events in 5m window. Severity: P2. Link: https://grafana.internal.redwood/alerts/1253 :rotating_light:
Alex: seeing this in the dashboard now, p95 is spiking to ~2s. Not all pods, looks like a handful hitting high CPU.
Maria: I can confirm increased error ratio on the proxy side too, kv-cache miss rate up ~3x. Might be hot keys.
Jin: @Alex @Maria tagging @Priya — can we get immediate mitigation? I can roll a config to reduce batch_size on the affected pool to ease latency.
Priya: on it. I'll push min-batch=4 for the eu-west1 pool and add a temporary traffic split to route new requests to the spare pool. Doing small change via rcli now.
OpsBot: Deploy job started: infra-deploy/emb-proxy-config@canary-1965. Job ID: 8672.
Priya: pushed change, rolling to 3 nodes. Monitoring.
Alex: after the change p95 dropped to 1.1s, p99 still ~2.2s but trending down. Good so far.
Maria: creating short-lived alert suppression for the noisy nodes so we don't get paged repeatedly while we stabilize. Using /pager silence for 30m.
oncall-bot: Incident created INC-4873: Embedding latency spike, eu-west1. Triage channel: #inc-4873.
Jin: quick customer-impact check — only internal QA traffic on that pool, no paid traffic routed per routing logs. Maria can you confirm?
Maria: confirmed — routing policy shows spares/qa pool took most of the traffic. No production key spikes. Logging link: https://logs.internal.redwood/streams/emb-proxy?query=pool:eu-west1
Priya: will follow up with a permanent mitigation: add KV hotspot detection and pre-split into hashed prefixes. But for post-incident action we should tune alert thresholds and update runbook steps.
Alex: agreed. Current alerts that fired: embed_encode_latency_p95 > 1.5s -> P2 page, embed_encode_error_rate > 0.5% -> P1 page. The latency one is noisy for transient backpressure; we should change it to a sustained window or add an adaptive threshold.
Jin: proposal: change latency alert to p95 > 1.5s sustained for 10m (was 5m), and add a runbook note to check KV miss rate / batching. Also create a Grafana panel that shows per-pod p95 and batch_size distribution.
Priya: I'll own the runbook edits. Ticketing: created RDW-9124 to update runbook and add sample queries.
Maria: Jin can you own the dashboard work? Add panel and add it to the oncall dashboard folder "Oncall > Embeddings".
Jin: yep, I'll add the panel and also add an annotation to the alert that links to runbook section once it's updated.
Alex: we should also add a short 'how to' snippet in the runbook for temporary mitigations: commands we used during the incident, e.g.:

```
# reduce batch size for a pool
rcli pools update --pool eu-west1-emb --set min_batch=4
# split traffic
rcli routing split --service embedding-proxy --from eu-west1 --to eu-west1-spare:20%
```

Priya: adding that snippet now. Also adding an action checklist: owners, dashboard link, alert query, playbook steps. Link to edit: https://wiki.internal.redwood/runbooks/embeddings-encode
Alex: note for postmortem — track autoscaler throttles. I saw a burst of scale events earlier that were limited by GPU quota on the nodepool. Add quota check to the runbook.
Maria: added an annotation in the alert config: "common cause: hot key -> kv-cache miss -> increased batching pressure" and linked to logs query.
Jin: dashboard panel added and linked to oncall dashboard. Panel ID: 402. URL: https://grafana.internal.redwood/d/0oncall/embeddings?panelId=402
Priya: runbook updated: added steps, snippet, ticket RDW-9124, and assigned ownership to Priya (runbook edits) and Jin (dashboard). Also put an entry to review the alert rule in 7 days.
Alex: leaving follow-ups:
- Jin: add per-tenant p95 breakdown to the dashboard (RDW-9130).
- Priya: implement KV hotspot detection RFC (RDW-9131).
- Maria: check autoscaler quota and propose quota bump if needed (RDW-9132).

Maria: marking incident INC-4873 as 'stabilized' at 1965433520. We'll keep suppression for another 30m to avoid churn.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-4873 status changed to stabilized by Maria.
OpsBot: Reminder: please annotate the runbook with the incident id (INC-4873) and link to the ticket RDW-9124 to close the loop.
Priya: added incident id and final timing notes to the runbook.
Alex: nice coordination everyone. We'll do a 30-min post-incident sync tomorrow to go over alerts and finalize tuning.
Jin: noted. I'll post a calendar invite and link to the short slide deck summarizing metrics.
Maria: closing thread for paging; leaving the follow-up tickets open. :white_check_mark:
Priya: thanks — all done from my side for the immediate changes.
Alex: closing loop, last_message_ts=1965433725"
